provenance: Shard rajab-a26: the proofs Ibn Rajab himself cites for the positions of its disputed furūʿ, recorded only where the record names one, every excerpt located verbatim in the pinned witness; tiers per Rawḍa v02 p389–390. No human review yet.

proofs.dalil: The ḥadīth of ʿAdī b. Ḥātim on game found after it was lost to sight
proofs.excerpt_ar: ولا أثر فيه غير سهمه فهل يحل أكله؟ على روايتين أصحهما أنه يحل لحديث عدي بن حاتم.
proofs.note: Ibn Rajab grounds the aṣaḥḥ riwāya of ḥill in the ḥadīth by name only: a ẓannī text.

proofs.dalil: Ibn ʿAbbās: «كل ما أصميت ودع ما أنميت»
proofs.excerpt_ar: والثانية: لا يحل لقول ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما كل ما أصميت ودع ما أنميت
proofs.note: The second riwāya rests on a Companion's saying: fatwā of a ṣaḥābī.
